layout.arrangement: Title centered at top inside a thin maroon-bordered header band; slide number '48' in a yellow circle at top-right corner. Below the header, two side-by-side panels separated by a vertical maroon line: left panel is a 2D scatter diagram with axes, right panel is a 1D projection/voting diagram with axes. Each panel has a maroon caption centered beneath it. The whole slide is enclosed in a double maroon border frame.

regions.name: header
regions.content: Title text 'K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) , K=3' with 'K-Nearest Neighbors' in dark red and '(KNN) , K=3' in blue; yellow circle with '48' at top-right

regions.name: left panel
regions.content: 2D scatter plot with L-shaped maroon axes; red query point near center-top connected by thin gray lines to surrounding colored points; three nearest neighbors circled with dashed magenta/purple rings; caption 'Select Nearest 3 Neighbors' below

regions.name: right panel
regions.content: 1D projection diagram: points projected onto a horizontal axis of red dots, vertical dotted gray lines rising to colored dots arranged along an increasing diagonal; vertical blue separator line near left; label 'K=3, cyan class' at top-left of panel; caption 'Vote on 3 Nearest Neighbors' below

layout.hierarchy: Title dominates (largest, bold, two-color). Panel captions are next most prominent (bold maroon). Diagrams are the main visual content. The 'K=3, cyan class' annotation is small black text with 'cyan' highlighted in cyan.

visual_elements.description: Left panel: 2D scatter with L-shaped maroon axes (vertical axis up, horizontal axis right, arrowheads). A single red query point near upper-center. Around it: a cluster of ~10 green points to the lower-left, a cluster of ~8 cyan points to the right, and ~5 tan/beige points below. Thin gray lines connect the red query point to many of the surrounding points. Three points are highlighted with dashed magenta/purple circles: two cyan points (upper area) and one green point (left of query), indicating the 3 nearest neighbors. Small dark tick marks appear next to several points.

Right panel: voting/projection diagram. Horizontal maroon axis at bottom holds a row of ~30 small red dots (projected positions). From each red dot a thin vertical dotted gray line rises to a colored dot; the colored dots (green, cyan, tan/beige) form an increasing diagonal staircase from lower-left to upper-right. A solid vertical blue line near the left side marks a decision/query position. Small red tick marks appear beside some dots. Annotation at top-left reads 'K=3, cyan class' with the word 'cyan' on a cyan highlight. A small curved arrow/pen mark appears mid-panel near a cyan dot.
Yellow circle containing black number '48' (slide number badge)
Double thin maroon rectangular border framing the entire slide, plus a horizontal maroon line under the header band and a vertical maroon divider between the two panels

typography_notes: Sans-serif throughout. Title is large and bold, mixed color: 'K-Nearest Neighbors' in dark red, '(KNN) , K=3' in blue. Panel captions are bold maroon, smaller than title. In-panel annotation 'K=3, cyan class' is small black text with 'cyan' highlighted with a cyan background. Slide number '48' is small black text inside the yellow circle.
animation_state: Appears fully built; no partially revealed elements. A small pen/cursor mark near the middle of the right panel suggests live annotation during the video.
